format: Each sprite is rows of characters; '.' is transparent and every other character is a palette key. One character = one pixel. Rows are already mirrored where the prototype mirrored them.

little_sister.note: 12x18 companion; same palette keys as the princess, recoloured by the dress-up choices

fairy.note: 14x14, has a soft #9EE7FF glow in the prototype

poof.note: 16x16 smoke when the unicorn beats the dragon

rating_star.note: 9x9 five-point star for maze ratings; an empty slot recolours y and w

footprint.note: 3x5 princess footprint, rotated to walk direction

arrow.note: 7x7 owl guide arrow (rotate per direction); also d-pad icon

floor_shadow.note: 16x2 dithered shadow under a wall, 28% opacity

dragon_puff.note: 24x20, faces right; mouth open while it puffs (the catch)

gem.note: 5x4 crystal wall decoration: a cut gem (not arrow-like, so it never reads as the owl's guide)

blossom.note: 5x5 spring wall decoration: a cherry blossom

leaf.note: 5x5 autumn wall decoration: a fallen leaf, tip up and right, stem down and left

pine.note: 5x6 winter wall decoration: a little pine with snow

pumpkin.note: 7x6 a little pumpkin: halloween's wall decoration (and its level card's)

shell_crack.note: 7x7 shell shard flying off when the turtle shield breaks

unicorn_sleep.note: 20x16, unicorn_a with closed eyes (asleep on the helper card)

santa.note: 16x20, faces right; waits on the helper spot (and is the helper card's picture)

sleigh.note: 24x16, faces right: Santa in his sleigh with a sack of presents; pulled by reindeer drawn in front

reindeer_a.note: 20x16, faces right; frame A. Pulls the sleigh, then stays behind to give rides

present.note: 7x7 Santa's present; b and B recoloured per present

unicorn_royal_a.note: 20x16, unicorn_a with a rainbow mane and gold hooves: the baby unicorn's mum

foal_a.note: 12x12, faces right: the baby unicorn; frame A

duck_a.note: 14x14, faces right: the duck (a white mother duck); waddle frame A

duck_fly.note: 14x14, faces right: the duck flying, wing up

duckling_a.note: 10x9, faces right: a duckling; waddle frame A

pond.note: 24x8 the duck's pond, as wide as the dragon; it paddles in it (the pond's bottom half is drawn again over the dragon)

swan_a.note: 16x16, faces right: the swan; walk frame A

swan_fly.note: 16x16, faces right: the swan flying, wing up

exclaim.note: 3x9 the dragon's fright: a red exclamation mark

princess_side.note: 16x24 jump mode: standing, facing right (princess_bare's keys, so the look recolours her)

princess_side_blink.note: 16x24 jump mode: princess_side with her eyes shut (a blink when she stands)

princess_run_b.note: 16x24 jump mode run 2 of 4 (a pixel up) (her hair bounces out)

princess_run_d.note: 16x24 jump mode run 4 of 4 (a pixel up) (her hair bounces out)

princess_jump.note: 16x24 jump mode: going up; her hair lifts

jump_ground_top.note: 16x16 jump mode: the ground's top tile (wall_block's keys, so themes recolour it)

jump_ground.note: 16x16 jump mode: the ground under its top tile

jump_block.note: 16x16 jump mode: a block standing on its own

jump_platform.note: 16x6 jump mode: a one-way platform, drawn at the top of its tile

jump_earth_top.note: 16x16 jump mode: earth ground's top tile (grass in the garden; themes recolour it)

jump_earth_top_b.note: 16x16 jump mode: earth ground's top tile, second look

jump_earth.note: 16x16 jump mode: the earth under its top tile

jump_earth_b.note: 16x16 jump mode: the earth under its top tile, second look

jump_earth_c.note: 16x16 jump mode: the earth under its top tile, with a stone

jump_earth_top_edge.note: 16x16 jump mode: earth ground's top tile at a left end (flipped for a right end)

jump_earth_edge.note: 16x16 jump mode: the earth at a left end (flipped for a right end)

jump_ground_top_edge.note: 16x16 jump mode: the brick ground's top tile at a left end (flipped for a right end)

jump_ground_edge.note: 16x16 jump mode: the brick ground at a left end (flipped for a right end)

jump_plank.note: 16x6 jump mode: a wooden one-way platform for the outdoor themes (winter's has snow on top)

jump_far_hills.note: 128x80 jump mode scenery behind the level (repeats across): rolling hills with bushes

jump_far_spikes.note: 128x80 jump mode scenery behind the level (repeats across): crystal spires

pumpkin_a.note: 14x12 jump mode: halloween's baddie, a smiling jack-o'-lantern hopping (up)

pumpkin_b.note: 14x12 jump mode: the jack-o'-lantern squashed as it lands

sister_side.note: 12x19 jump mode: the little sister standing, facing right (little_sister's keys)

sister_side_blink.note: 12x19 jump mode: sister_side with her eyes shut (a blink when she stands)

sister_run_a.note: 12x19 jump mode: the little sister, run a

sister_run_b.note: 12x19 jump mode: the little sister, run b

princess_land.note: 16x24 jump mode: landing, a pixel lower for a moment

princess_seated.note: 16x22 jump mode: sitting on the throne, crowned, facing us

amb_petal.note: 3x2 jump mode ambience: a blossom petal drifting down (spring)

amb_twinkle.note: 3x3 jump mode ambience: a twinkle in the crystal caves

amb_glint.note: 3x1 jump mode ambience: a glint on the summer sea

amb_seagull_a.note: 7x3 jump mode ambience: a seagull far off, wings up

amb_seagull_b.note: 7x3 jump mode ambience: a seagull far off, wings down
